$comment: [[D-C-TAG-DEFINED-IN-A-PARAMETER-LIST-REFUSED]] runtime witness for the FIRST of the two exemptions to the one-scope rule (C 6.2.1p4: a definition's parameter list and its body's outermost block are one scope). An ENUMERATOR declared in that block may repeat a parameter's name. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-23: MSVC 19.51 (/std:clatest) BUILDS this file and RUNS it to 42 — the enumerator hides the parameter — while gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 (-std=c2x and -std=c17) and MinGW gcc refuse it. One working reference makes it required, so DSS keeps accepting it while it now refuses the object, static, typedef and extern-function redeclarations all four references refuse.
$commentWhyNotVacuous: The argument is 0 and the enumerator is 42: an exit of 0 means the body read the PARAMETER, i.e. the enumerator was bound somewhere the body does not see, and a refusal means the exemption was lost.
